steps.title: SIMULATED demonstration
steps.caption: Real server code, fake Microsoft Graph transport. Tenant 0000…, domain contoso-demo.onmicrosoft.com, fictional users. No network, no credentials, no live Microsoft operation.

steps.title: MCP read: get_user
steps.caption: The model asks a read-only question. Fixed Graph template, fixed field allowlist, admin targets refused before any call.

result.note: Microsoft Graph exposes no lockout flag; smart lockout clears itself (60 s, growing) and is not readable or clearable by API. Use get_sign_in_logs to see failed sign-ins.

steps.title: MCP read: get_last_sign_in
steps.caption: signInActivity is returned with its documented 24 h lag noted; when Graph has nothing, the tool says 'unknown', never 'never signed in'.

steps.title: Input validation
steps.caption: Hostile or malformed arguments are rejected by the strict schema (UPN regex + tenant domain, extra fields forbidden). Zero Graph calls.

error.message: upn: Value error, userPrincipalName must look like name@domain with letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' only; extra: Extra inputs are not permitted

steps.title: DENIED: write against an admin
steps.caption: disable_account on a deny-listed admin is refused at proposal time by the target guard. No proposal is created. Zero Graph calls.

error.message: this account is protected by the server's deny list; no tool may target it

steps.title: Write tool = proposal only
steps.caption: revoke_sessions does not touch Graph. It records a proposal with a SHA-256 digest over (tool, args, target, graph call) and a 10-minute expiry.

args.reason: INC0042 lost laptop, revoke all sessions

result.would_do: revoke all sessions/refresh tokens for carol.demo@contoso-demo.onmicrosoft.com
result.next_step: A human must approve in Terminal: entra-mcp approve apr_8b7d1c96999a8587  (then call approve with this id). Nothing has changed yet.

steps.title: The AI cannot approve its own proposal
steps.caption: Calling the approve tool on a pending proposal is refused: status is 'pending', not 'approved'. Only the Terminal CLI can change that.

error.message: proposal apr_8b7d1c96999a8587 is not approved by a human yet. A person must run in Terminal: entra-mcp approve apr_8b7d1c96999a8587

steps.title: HUMAN approval in Terminal (simulated)
steps.caption: A person reviews the proposal and runs the CLI. This is the only code path that moves a proposal to 'approved'. The MCP server never calls it.

result.summary: revoke all sessions/refresh tokens for carol.demo@contoso-demo.onmicrosoft.com

steps.title: Approved execution
steps.caption: Now the approve tool claims the proposal (digest re-verified), sends exactly one write with the operator's delegated token, and records the outcome. No automatic retry.

result.note: takes effect within minutes; already-issued access tokens live until expiry

steps.title: Replay refused
steps.caption: The same approval id a second time: the proposal is already 'executed'. Single use, enforced by the store under a file lock.

error.message: proposal apr_8b7d1c96999a8587 is executed; proposals are single use

steps.title: Audit trail (redacted JSONL)
steps.caption: Every call, allowed or refused, is one line: tool, action, target, actor, decision, Graph status, request id. Tokens and secrets never appear (scan of this run's audit + approval files: clean).

result.error: invalid_arguments: upn: Value error, userPrincipalName must look like name@domain with letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' only; extra: Extra inputs are not permitted
protected: this account is protected by the server's deny list; no tool may target it
not_approved: proposal apr_8b7d1c96999a8587 is not approved by a human yet. A person must run in Terminal: entra-mcp approve apr_8b7d1c96999a8587
not_executable: proposal apr_8b7d1c96999a8587 is executed; proposals are single use

steps.title: Not demonstrated: Intune device actions
steps.caption: sync_device and reboot_device are implemented and mock-tested, gated on a config allowlist of device ids, and still PENDING a disposable enrolled device. Nothing in this demo was a live Microsoft Graph result.
